# Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy

## Accrual

Full-time employees accrue 1.75 days of PTO per month worked, totalling 21
days per year. Accrual begins on the employee's start date and PTO can be
used as soon as it is accrued - there is no waiting period. Part-time
employees accrue PTO on a pro-rated basis according to their scheduled
hours.

## Carryover

Up to 5 unused PTO days may be carried over into the next calendar year.
Any accrued PTO beyond that cap is forfeited at year-end unless local law
requires otherwise. Carried-over days must be used within the first quarter
of the new year.

## Requesting Time Off

PTO requests should be submitted through the HR system at least 5 business
days in advance for planned absences. Requests are approved by the direct
manager based on team coverage. Sick time does not require advance notice -
notify your manager as soon as reasonably possible.

## Sick Leave

Separate from PTO, employees receive 10 paid sick days per year for illness,
medical appointments, or caring for an immediate family member. Unused sick
days do not carry over and are not paid out on separation.

## Payout on Separation

Unused, accrued PTO (up to the carryover cap) is paid out at the employee's
current base rate upon termination or resignation, in accordance with
applicable state or local law.
